title: Reading a numbered syscall test
description: You can separate the custom-kernel test's intent from its supplied result.

steps.description: The user program stores 285 in syscallnum. The deck assigns this number to a custom syscall in its specified kernel setup.
You pass that number to syscall and print its result under the label Process ID. This statement uses the numeric interface rather than a named custom wrapper.

steps.question: Does the Process ID label establish that the call succeeded?
steps.answer: No. The label is fixed text, and the supplied recording shows a result of -1.

steps.description: You see Process ID: -1 followed by the program's return. This recording supplies no successful process ID or errno detail to identify the failure.
